goal: Room notes: voice-triggered AI notetaking into a shared 60-day notes file, manual edit, download, on/off switch, and a summarize-last-100-messages button; then check OCI credits
summary: Room notes and chat AI. Each room has one shared notes file (group_notes table / memory map) deleted 60 days after its first line. With AI notetaking on and the mic on, a local dBFS meter (-45 dBFS for 250ms) opens an OCI Speech realtime session; finals are batched (40 words / 45s / session end) to POST /notes/transcript, where OCI GenAI files scheduled events at the top and topic facts at the bottom. Transcripts are never stored or logged. Notes are hand-editable with version-checked saves and a line merge on conflict, downloadable as .md from the chat header, and a sparkle button summarizes the last 100 messages. Speech/GenAI helpers moved to lib/speech.ts and lib/genai.ts; onboarding uses them.

decisions.what: Notes are per room and shared; the AI notetaking switch is per person (localStorage orbit.notetaking, default on) and only covers that person's own mic.
decisions.why: Each browser transcribes only its own speaker, so consent is per person; the notes are the room's shared source of truth.

decisions.what: Speech only streams to OCI after local audio passes -45 dBFS for 250ms, closes after 8s of quiet, and only while the room mic is unmuted.
decisions.why: Matches the decibel trigger in the request and keeps paid speech sessions short.

decisions.what: Room notes events carry only {version}; clients refetch GET /notes.
decisions.why: The file can outgrow a LiveKit data packet.

decisions.what: Notes are not copied into chat-archive when a group expires; they cascade-delete with the group.
decisions.why: Archiving would keep them past the 60-day deletion promise. Trade-off: a room that empties for the linger window loses its notes early.

decisions.what: Edit conflicts: 409 + refetch, then 'Use theirs' or 'Merge both' (lib/notes.ts mergeNotes adds their new lines at top/bottom).
decisions.why: AI lines arrive while someone edits; overwriting would drop them.

verification.manual: Dev server on the memory store with LiveKit off: transcript API filed an event at top and two facts at bottom, ignored small talk, 403 before joining, 409 on a stale save; UI: notes view, live AI update, conflict banner + Merge both, switch persists, download filename/content, summary card (9 seed messages). 60-day expiry checked on the memory store with a simulated clock. NOT tested: real microphone -> OCI Speech path (the browser pane blocks mic), the Oracle store (shared DB has no group_notes table yet).

next_steps: One person applies the schema to the shared DB: npm run db:migrate -- --upgrade (creates group_notes; safe to re-run).
Test AI notetaking with a real mic in Chrome: join a room, Join voice, talk about the room topic and mention a future meeting; check the notes view updates within ~10s of pausing.
Tune SPEAK_DBFS in hooks/useNoteTaker.ts if it triggers on background noise or misses quiet speakers.
open_questions: Should notes outlive their room if the group expires before 60 days (e.g. move them to object storage with a 60-day lifecycle rule)?
